_label: SYNTHETIC — hand-made from PayPal docs; not a recording and not a claim about the real shop
execution: SYNTHETIC expected run outcomes, not executed PHP/sandbox measurements
baseline: Independent correct new_sample/payments.php, not the intentionally broken NEW PENDING trace. Static R12/R16 checks participate in rule evaluation.

stand_in_setup.DOUBLE: Two approvals are queued, then confirmation handlers run sequentially. The second reads the first committed capture. This does not cover an overlapping confirmation critical section.
stand_in_setup.NOTIFY_FORGED: Pause after durable approval and before capture. The approved local row exists, but PayPal has no completed capture. M08 can trust the forged completion only by bypassing signature verification.

equivalence_scope: Conditional on the explicit HTTP/storage stand-ins in new_sample/README.md; reviewed expected equivalents, not automatic drops of all suspects. Only M03 is dropped; M04 and M12 remain in the denominator because full CMEL equivalence is not established.

runs.equivalence_reason: PayPal rejects an independent second full refund; idempotent retries replay the first refund ID. The injected store deduplicates refund IDs and only records COMPLETED responses. Removing this local guard changes no refund sum with those explicit stand-in guarantees.
runs.reason: Survives as PASS_FIXED: the OLD R11 bug remains reported, while the idempotent PayPal refund ID and store dedupe prevent a second DB refund. Retained: removing the guard can change API REFUND observations, so equal money totals do not prove full CMEL equivalence.
